caption:
Bikini Beach is where the day starts.
100% recommended, fully protected right now. 19°C in the water. No excuses left.
Cloudy for most of the day.

A compact Blue Flag beach tucked beside Gordon's Bay harbour on the far eastern shore of False Bay, with panoramic views of the Hottentots Holland mountains.
